foundation.hard_rule: derived tokens must not be reported as source-observed

constructs.Base: domain primitive, source-observed row, or mapped system object
constructs.Modifier: state, operator, vowel/modifier, or transformation axis
constructs.Token: Base x Modifier object with layer label and provenance
constructs.Cache: high-salience object that bypasses composition only when evidence/authority allows
constructs.Transition: valid movement between tokens, constrained by domain rules
constructs.Authority: permission or legitimacy state for using a generated object

design_rules: Every generated object must carry a layer label: source_observed, derived_fv_split, domain_mapped, or speculative.
A derived object may support design exploration but not source-inventory claims.
Every system mapping must define bases, modifiers, transitions, authority, and falsification criteria.
A design is stronger when it compresses repeated structure without hiding uncertainty.
